Messages.Author: Dhar...@yahoo.com
Messages.Body:
In article <S%962.1211$_g.63...@news.rdc1.sfba.home.com>,
"Umax Boy" <Sup...@umax.com> wrote:
> Can you stack Anarch Revolt so everyone loses multiple pool every turn? I
> know that Army of Rats damage does not stack.

Anarch Revolt is cumulative.

Army of Rats has a specific clause that states, "You may only burn 1 pool with
Army of Rats cards each turn." Anarch Revolt has no such clause.
